scope: Fake SDK contract tests; not live ad acceptance
checks: missing configuration/platform/old SDK never creates an ad
only explicit completed close rewards once; show resolution alone is not a reward
early exit and absent completion flag earn nothing
load/show rejection and SDK errors settle and release retry
loading cancel/timeout cannot later open a stale video
opening timeout recovers; active playback is not cut off by a loading timer
old SDK instance cannot complete the next request
dispose and cleanup exceptions still settle; late callbacks ignored
